name: Helen

skills.name: Sentinel
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Freeze damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Aegis Command
skills.description: Selects an ally (excluding self) within a 6 tile radius and applies Aegis on it. If unit with Aegis takes damage within 6 tiles from Helen, she will share 100% of initial damage on their behalf, as well as cleansing Taunt and Fear. Aegis can be applied only to one target. After skill usage, gains Extra Command.

skills.name: Shield Charge
skills.description:
Selects 1 tile within a cross-shaped area of 4 to 8 tiles and lands on the selected tile. All allied units along the path will have one debuff cleansed and gain Frost Shield that absorbs 100% of Helen's initial attack damage, up to a maximum of 100% of the target's maximum health. Generates Frost tiles along the path for 2 turns.
For each allied unit (excluding self) on the path, the effectiveness of this Frost Shield is increased by 30%, and restores 2 points of stability to Helen. After skill usage, Helen gains 6 tiles of Additional Movement and can use her basic attack.

skills.name: Banner Sentinel
skills.description: Selects an ally (excluding self) within a 6 tile radius and applies Attack Up III and Defense Up III to them for 2 turns. In addition, reduces Ultimate cooldown of all Freeze-attribute Dolls (excluding self) on the field by 1 turn. After skill usage, Helen gains Additional Command.

skills.name: Fearless Valkyrie
skills.description:
Helen is immune to the following effects: healing reduction, healing prevention or effects that convert healing into damage.
At the start of battle, increases Helen's defense and Max HP by 30%.
At the start of each turn, Helen gains 2 points of Confectance Index, restores 25% of HP, and cleanse all debuffs from self.
For every instance of damage taken, Helen gains 1 stack of Overedge.
When Helen has Overedge, the damage multiplier of her basic attacks is increased to 180%.
Before Helen performs a basic attack, her attack is increased by 15% of her defence.

fortification.effect: Increases width by 2 tiles, cleanse 2 additional debuffs, and applies Critical Damage Up II for 2 turns.

Increases the Stability Gauge to 16 points, reducing damage taken by 50%. Each time
you take damage, you gain an additional stack of Overedge. Before performing a basic attack, increase your attack power by 30% of your defense.
Cooldown is reduced by 2 turns. Gain Attack Up III and Defense Up III for 2 turns. Gain 10 stacks of Overedge. Reduces Ultimate cooldown of Freeze-attribute Dolls by 2 turns .

Additionally removes Infatuated and Stun. If fatal damage is taken while sharing damage, Helen will not die and will recover HP equal to 150% of her defense. This effect can be triggered up to once per round. Friendly units with Aegis deal 30% more Freeze damage.
For each allied unit (excluding self) on the path, an additional 2 points of stability are restored, and the corresponding number of layers of Frost Drive are gained.

Before performing a basic attack, increase Helen attack by 70% of her defense .
When a friendly unit takes damage, gain 2 stacks of Overedge. While having Overedge, the damage multiplier of basic attacks is increased to 300%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - The Two-Headed Spy
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, Helen gains 3 stacks of Overedge

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Frostbite Bloom
keys.effect: When performing basic attacks against boss units, Freeze damage dealt is increased by 20%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Buried Memories
keys.effect: Before performing a basic attack, dispel 2 buffs from the enemy target.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Guardian's Resolve
keys.effect: At the end of Helen's action, applies 2 stacks of Shelter to herself and all allied units with Aegis.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Glory to Mommies
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, if Helen's HP is above 30%, she gains Glory to Mommies, preventing her defense from being reduced below less than 100%. Cancels when Helen's HP is below 30%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Enforcer of Order
keys.effect: Reduces stability damage taken by 2 points, and grants immunity to Stun and Fear.

keys.name: Common Key - Immovable Defense
keys.effect: DEF +5.0% / If the user's defense is greater than or equal to the target's Defense, their damage dealt is increased by 10%.
